text:
Maya Patel: hey team — addressed the serialization comments and added a unit + integration test. also added a short smoke checklist in the PR description. PTAL when you have a minute; hoping to push a light canary tonight if nothing else pops up.
Jordan Li: thanks — looking now. saw one flaky assertion in CI but it repros locally for me, pushing a tiny follow-up in a sec (no functional change).
Maya Patel: cool, pushed the tiny fix. CI kicked off again.
Samir Gupta: i'll take a quick look after the rebuild. if it's green i'm happy to be merge custodian. any preference squash vs retain history?
Jordan Li: no strong preference, small cleanup commit could be squashed. leaving that to ship ops.
deploy-bot: canary slot reserved: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC for team/eng (auto-reservation) :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: perfect — smoke steps pasted here so ops can run quickly:
```
# smoke (local)
./scripts/run-smoke --target=api --quick --focus=serialization
# smoke (staging)
kubectl apply -f k8s/test-canary.yaml && ./scripts/staging-smoke --endpoint https://staging-redwood.example
```
Jordan Li: gave a quick LGTM — only left one optional nit about a comment link. otherwise looks good to me. :thumbsup:
Samir Gupta: if CI stays green i'll merge at ~22:05 UTC and watch canary for 30m. tagging @Maya Patel so you're in the loop.
Maya Patel: thanks all — PTAL final time. i'll be around on standby for any fallout. :pray:
